new_insert_email_body.text:
Hi Emma,

Just a quick follow-up — to lock in your Paris hotel, we need a brief call to confirm the reservation. I noticed your Team Sync meeting currently overlaps with our available slot. Please reschedule Team Sync to May 29, 2024, from 10:00 to 11:00 AM so we can finalize everything on the phone. Once that’s moved, I’ll confirm the lowest-priced option right away.

Best,
Wonder Trips Travel Agency
